prompts.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create a NEW panoramic illustration for a Stanford beginner social-dance club recruitment poster. This is OPTION A, "Campus casual".
Wide 2.6:1 horizontal banner, ideally about 2600x1000 pixels. Show four adult university students, two relaxed partner-dance pairs, doing simple upright beginner side steps at easy arm's length in a sunlit Stanford-like sandstone courtyard. All four wear ordinary campus clothes: T-shirts, one cardigan, blue jeans or loose casual trousers, and flat everyday sneakers clearly visible. Women in trousers, no skirts or dresses. Varied body types and skin tones. Light friendly laughter, relaxed posture, believable small steps, low-stakes first-class energy. One pair comfortably holds hands at waist height, other learning an easy open-position step. NO dips, NO backbends, NO lifted arms, NO advanced poses, NO sensual costuming, NO heels, NO shiny professional dance shoes. Refined painterly editorial illustration with lightly textured gouache, charming natural faces, warm cream negative space, understated cardinal red and plum clothing accents, soft terracotta arches and palms in distant background. Keep whole bodies and sneakers visible with comfortable margins. High artistic quality, welcoming and lively rather than performance glamour. All people anatomically plausible with distinct limbs and natural hands. No visible text, letters, logos, badges, QR codes, borders or watermark. The art will sit beneath an independently typeset headline; do not draw any flyer text.

Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset: NEW panoramic banner illustration for a beginner-friendly university Bachata and Brazilian Zouk dance club poster. OPTION B, "Your first class".
Composition: wide 2.6:1 landscape image around 2600x1000 pixels. A relaxed student-led dance workshop in a simple university multipurpose room, plain pale walls, warm wood floor, broad windows with a hint of sandstone campus outdoors. Six adult students with varied genders, skin tones and body types. Two pairs facing each other practice easy upright basic steps with loose hands at waist level. Two others at the side follow the rhythm individually, smiling and joining in. Nobody is performing. Loose T-shirts, casual sweater, jeans, comfy long trousers, everyday flat sneakers throughout. No dresses, skirts, high heels, stagewear or dance costumes. All heads, hands and footwear inside frame. Bags and two water bottles along a distant wall quietly establish real class atmosphere. Friendly, human, low pressure. Hand-drawn editorial style: soft colored pencil outlines with flat gouache fill, terracotta, cream, plum, pale lavender, muted mustard; slightly imperfect illustrated forms and broad warm smiles. A polished colorful club flyer illustration, not children's cartoon, not stock photography, not a glamour performance. No acrobatic moves, dips, splits, lunges or backbends. No mirrors creating doubled people. No text, letters, signs, logos, symbols, QR codes or watermark. Art only, typography will be added separately.

Use case: ads-marketing.
Create new artwork for OPTION C, "Just come dance": an exuberant, modern graphic illustration for a beginner university social-dance club.
Very wide 2.6:1 horizontal banner, ideally 2600x1000 pixels. FOUR adult students dancing casually in two loose pairs, full bodies and flat ordinary sneakers visible, upright easy side steps, friendly simple smiles, natural bodies, all wearing jeans or loose casual pants and plain T-shirts / oversized sweater. Nobody wearing a dress, skirt, heels, costume or special dancewear. Welcome-to-the-club energy. People look like regular young adults, not professional dancers.
STYLE MUST BE BOLD FLAT PAPER-CUT / RISOGRAPH EDITORIAL ART, not painterly realism or photography. Big playful shapes, simplified lively faces, striking silhouettes, confident hand-drawn contours, subtle print grain, college arts-festival poster quality, contemporary and sophisticated. Pale butter yellow paper background, vivid coral, deep plum, cobalt and lilac accents. A minimal terracotta arch and one palm shape in the background hint at Stanford. Rhythm marks and overlapping abstract shapes at edges, open central negative space, joyous but not cluttered. No ballroom poses, no lifts, no deep dips, no backbends. Simple believable partner hand connections at waist level. Strong warm graphic composition clearly different from a realistic painting.
NO text, NO letters, NO logos, NO QR codes, NO watermark. Art only; poster typography added separately.
